verdict.rationale: Letta documents a first-party Scheduled Tasks feature that automates prompts to an agent on a recurring schedule or at a specific future time. This covers recurring scheduling, not just one-off runs. The cloud-agents docs also position schedules as a way to build always-on agents that run while your laptop is closed. Missing for 10: details on schedule syntax and management (cron expressions, listing, editing, pausing), run history or failure handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled runs work reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Scheduled tasks allow you to automate prompts to your agent on a recurring schedule or at a specific time in the future.
Combining agents with Slack and schedules allows you to create always-on digital coworkers.
Agents can still be messaged even if your laptop is closed, since they have their own computer to run on.
